headline: Development builds gain reflections, editor controls and co-op fixes
summary: Players on the Development channel gain environment reflections, smoother input options and fixes for the Drone Device and Novalis sparks. The channel now follows develop directly (#111). Creators get a guided level-editor panel and controls to re-extract levels or start over (#105, #107). Custom ship destinations landed through #104, but its originating proposal described PAL-only support and gameplay testing still outstanding.
highlights: Enhanced rendering adds reflections for water, chrome and glass, with probe placement around rooms, corridors, jumps and swimming areas (#119). Its 19,210 added lines account for roughly half the day's 38,239 additions.
Co-op world calls keep addressing the level while menus are open, and remote gloves animate correctly (#99, #120). Persistent savestate support lands for external mods through interface 1.10 (#103).
Installed editor tools retain typed edits, and level background colours and sky textures gain fixes for modding (#100, #108).
Native mods gain Android support, with SDK 1.10.1 and matching template pins (#110, #117, #118).
Optional fresh pad reads and low-latency frames are off by default (#122). NTSC-U save overwrite prompts work again, and language and Exit text survive Quit Game (#121, #126).
An unusable-camera guard lands after an unreproduced black-screen report (#114). Mod updates at startup, saved links and pad bindings remain an open proposal (#123).
